info.name: OAN Auth Service - Fayda login (IAM)
info.description:
Login through Fayda (VeriFayda 2.0 / eSignet 1.8) via oan_auth_service /v1/auth/iam/login.

Unlike the Keycloak collection this cannot be scripted end to end: Fayda needs a real person (OTP or biometrics) and consent. Flow: run 1, open `authorization_url` in a browser and sign in, paste the final redirect URL into `fayda_redirect_url` in the environment, then run 2-4.

Needs the `fayda` OAN IAM Service (provider_id 2) and the Fayda row in iam_bene.login_providers. The Fayda client's registered redirect URI must equal the provider's oauth_callback_url. Select the "OAN Auth Fayda Login (local)" environment.

request.description: Starts the login transaction for the `fayda` OAN IAM Service. IAM answers with the Fayda authorize URL (PKCE, state, nonce). Copy `authorization_url` from the collection variables (or the console) into a browser for step 2.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get(k)) { throw new Error("Set `" + k + "` in the OAN Auth Fayda Login environment"); }
console.log("[F1] Open this URL in a browser and sign in with Fayda:", data.redirect_url);

item.name: 2. Complete IAM callback with the pasted Fayda redirect URL

request.description: Manual step before this: open `authorization_url` in a browser, sign in at Fayda (OTP or biometrics) and approve consent. Fayda redirects to the registered redirect URI (e.g. http://localhost:3000/callback?code=...&state=...). Nothing needs to be listening there: copy the full URL from the address bar into `fayda_redirect_url` in the "OAN Auth Fayda Login (local)" environment. This request forwards `code` and `state` to the IAM API callback, which exchanges the code (private_key_jwt + PKCE) and sets the X-Access-Token cookie.

exec: if (!pasted) { throw new Error("Paste the final Fayda redirect URL (localhost:3000/callback?state=...&code=...) into `fayda_redirect_url` in the OAN Auth Fayda Login environment"); }
q.split("#")[0].split("&").forEach(function (p) { var kv = p.split("="); if (kv[0]) { params[kv[0]] = kv[1] || ""; } });
if (params.error) { throw new Error("Fayda returned error=" + params.error + " " + decodeURIComponent(params.error_description || "")); }
if (!params.code || !params.state) { throw new Error("The pasted URL has no code/state"); }
// IAM keeps a login for 300 s, keyed by its state. Catch a stale or mismatched callback here,
// where the cause is known, rather than as IAM's "Login Provider Id not received".
throw new Error("This callback belongs to an older login, not the latest step 1. Sign in with the current `authorization_url` (or resend step 1 and use its URL), then paste that callback.");
throw new Error("Login expired: IAM keeps it for 5 minutes and step 1 ran " + Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000) + " s ago. Resend step 1, sign in, and send step 2 within 5 minutes.");
pm.test("IAM callback redirects after exchange (302/303/307)", function () {
console.log("[F2] Acquired fayda_access_token from IAM cookie");
} catch (err) { console.log("[F2] access token is not a decodable JWT:", String(err)); }
